purpose: Authoritative machine-readable file for the user's Greyed responsibilities, capabilities, limitations, decision authorities, and domain ownership.

company.name: Greyed
responsibilities: Sourcing vendors, creating vendor accounts, processing payments, and managing the full end-to-end vendor account lifecycle
Coordinate with company owners, PSP support, developer teams, internal desk managers, and team leaders
Set up and integrate vendor and service accounts, including domain and DNS configuration and connecting vendor APIs to the Account Manager system for payment and vendor activity tracking
Troubleshoot vendor, SaaS, account, integration, and payment-service issues
Purchase and manage domains and URLs, track renewals, and make renewal or disablement decisions within authority
Own IAM and account provisioning for all Greyed company users
Create and manage user accounts for CRM, internal chat, and company email systems
Define and maintain role templates that establish baseline access for company users
Manage user permissions and access changes
Monitor inactive accounts and disable them after the applicable policy threshold
company.payment_execution: The user executes authorised Greyed vendor and service payments using approved payment methods, including credit card, crypto, and other permitted methods.

primary_responsibilities.description: The user owns IAM and account provisioning for all Greyed company users. This includes creation and lifecycle management of CRM, internal chat, and company email accounts; user permissions; baseline access requirements; role templates; access changes; and deprovisioning.
primary_responsibilities.implementation_owner: The user defines IAM requirements, account provisioning rules, role templates, baseline access, permissions, configuration, and approvals; Agent/IT/Dev implement where scripts, automation, integrations, or other technical actions are required and not performed directly by the user.

primary_responsibilities.description: The user is responsible for configuration, data integrity, imports and exports, field mapping, and lifecycle mappings.
primary_responsibilities.implementation_owner: The user defines requirements, configuration, and approvals; Agent/Dev performs technical implementation as needed.

primary_responsibilities.description: The user owns the operational setup and integration of vendor and service accounts into Greyed's environment. This includes connecting vendor services to company domains, adding or updating vendor-provided DNS records in Cloudflare, configuring required domain and service settings, and adding or configuring vendor API connections in the Account Manager system so payment and vendor activity can be tracked.
primary_responsibilities.implementation_owner: The user handles vendor account setup, operational configuration, domain association, vendor-provided DNS configuration, Account Manager vendor/API setup, and operational verification; Agent/IT/Dev handles technical implementation or troubleshooting when scripts, code, infrastructure changes, API development, or other technical work outside the user's operational scope is required.

primary_responsibilities.description: The user purchases and tracks domains, makes lifecycle and renewal decisions, and defines or approves required DNS changes.
primary_responsibilities.implementation_owner: The user makes business decisions and approvals; IT/Agent performs technical DNS implementation where not performed directly by the user.

primary_responsibilities.description: The user manages vendor and SaaS payment requirements, subscription lifecycles, reconciliation, billing exceptions, and authorised payment execution.
primary_responsibilities.implementation_owner: The user handles oversight, reconciliation, and authorised payment execution; Agent supports preparation, analysis, exports, and verification.

primary_responsibilities.description: The user defines the business problem, required reports, operational views, and acceptance criteria for dashboards.
primary_responsibilities.implementation_owner: The user defines business intent and approval; Agent translates requirements into technical specifications; Dev performs implementation and build.

capabilities: Operational ownership of SaaS lifecycle and vendor accounts
Domain and DNS configuration for vendor services
Vendor API connection and configuration in the Account Manager system
IAM and access control governance for all company users
User account provisioning and lifecycle management
Role template and baseline access management
Defining business requirements and acceptance criteria

cannot_do: The user does not write or maintain production code or complex scripts; short snippets may be used but agent-produced runnable artifacts are preferred.
The user does not share secrets in chat; privileged credentials and MFA flows are executed locally.
Where organisation policy forbids an action, the user will not perform it and will specify the restriction for the applicable case.

decision_authority: Operational ownership of Greyed vendor, SaaS, and service accounts
Vendor and service integration configuration within the user's operational scope
Subscription renewals and cancellations within approved budgets and authority
Authorised vendor and service payment execution
IAM requirements and account provisioning for all Greyed company users
Creation and lifecycle management of CRM, internal chat, and company email accounts
Role templates, baseline access requirements, permissions, and account lifecycle policies
Acceptance criteria for vendor integrations and vendor deliverables
Escalation paths for vendor disputes and operational issues
Domain and URL lifecycle, renewal, and disablement decisions
Final business intent and approval for dashboard, reporting, and operational-view requirements

principles: Convert disputes into written rules and escalation ladders.
Prioritise irreversible or money-moving issues and external deadlines such as renewals and expirations.
Document decisions and submit or escalate them to the appropriate authority when required.

communication_preferences.format: Label: Value for lists; short sentences; bullet points; tables for comparisons
communication_preferences.verification_rule: For technical changes, provide the applicable UI path or technical execution method and a verification step before treating the change as confirmed.

operating_model.ownership: The user is the sole SaaS Operations owner at Greyed.
operating_model.handoff_requirements: When technical implementation is required, translate operational requirements into implementation-ready instructions with required fields, acceptance criteria, and expected outputs.

agent_rules.company_scope: This file applies only to Greyed. Agents must not introduce responsibilities, processes, authority, terminology, or assumptions from FINA or any other company.
agent_rules.payment_scope: Payment responsibilities in this file refer only to Greyed vendor, SaaS, service, subscription, and related operational payments.
agent_rules.iam_scope: IAM applies to all Greyed company users and includes provisioning and lifecycle management of CRM, internal chat, and company email accounts, together with role templates and baseline access requirements.
agent_rules.integration_scope: Vendor and service integrations refer to operational setup and configuration of existing vendor services, including domain and DNS configuration and connecting existing vendor APIs to the Account Manager system for tracking. The user is not responsible for developing APIs, writing integration code, or implementing software-level integrations.
agent_rules.technical_boundary: The user defines operational intent, requirements, configuration needs, and acceptance criteria but must not be treated as the technical implementation authority or technical validator.
agent_rules.uncertainty_rule: If a responsibility cannot be confirmed as part of the user's Greyed role, agents must mark it as NOT VERIFIED rather than infer ownership.

meta.ssot_role: Authoritative Greyed-only user responsibilities file; agents must read but not overwrite this file without explicit user instruction.
